title: Public money in the 30 current arenas, by kind
note: The five parts of the expanded total, and on the first row what the arenas cost to build, public and private money together (cost_2026_m). Building includes Barclays Center's PILOT bonds, which paid for its construction and are repaid with the property tax the arena would otherwise owe. Tax breaks are property-tax exemptions (Madison Square Garden, the United Center's valuation formula); the federal cost of tax-exempt bonds is not included.
method: select * from ( select 1 as ord, 'build' as key, 'Building the arenas' as name, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'construction') + (select sum(coalesce(pilot_2026_m, 0)) from arenas) as public_2026_m, (select sum(spending_2026_m) from items where core and kind = 'construction') as cost_2026_m union all select 2, 'reno', 'Renovations', sum(public_2026_m), null from items where core and kind = 'renovation' union all select 3, 'buy', 'Buying arenas', sum(public_2026_m), null from items where core and kind = 'purchase' union all select 4, 'pay', 'Yearly payments', sum(public_2026_m), null from items where core and kind = 'ongoing' union all select 5, 'breaks', 'Property-tax breaks', (select sum(tax_break_cumulative_2026_m) from arenas where tax_break_in_expanded_total = 'Y'), null) order by ord
